//: staging environment (10.1.1-T1.1). Account, region and replica counts are [OPEN]
in docs/runbooks/environments.md until 10.8.1 (O3) picks a provider; this file
declares the EVIDGATE_* surface staging answers for, its probe behaviour and its
Required rows (matrix required.staging = true) must be declared here; the
secrets are injected from the provider secret store at deploy time (10.1.1-T2/T3)
and never live in this repository (00 §5.7 S3).
description: Pre-production environment on its own provider account with its own database, bucket and credentials and sanitised data (FR-10-1): a deploy reaches it exactly as prod is reached, so a release is proven before the pilot. Load tests run here and never against prod (area plan §3). Provider, region and replica counts are [OPEN] pending 10.8.1 (O3).

EVIDGATE__DATABASE__CONNECTIONSTRING.from: provider secret store (10.1.1-T3), injected as an environment variable at deploy; Username=evidgate_app, staging's own host and database — no path or credential is shared with prod (AC4)

EVIDGATE__ISOLATION__SELFCHECK.from: not set: the option default Required applies; Disabled is only for hosts that boot without a database

EVIDGATE__TASKS__QUEUEROUTES__<n>__QUEUE.from: empty route list until 10.2.2 routes a task type

EVIDGATE__TASKS__QUEUEROUTES__<n>__TASKT.from: empty route list until 10.2.2 routes a task type

EVIDGATE__TASKS__QUEUES__<n>__CONCURRENC.from: empty queue list; the schedule-declared queues are consumed at DefaultQueueConcurrency

EVIDGATE__TASKS__QUEUES__<n>__NAME.from: empty queue list; the schedule-declared queues are consumed at DefaultQueueConcurrency

EVIDGATE__TASKS__SWEEPCONNECTIONSTRING.from: provider secret store; a staging-only evidgate_worker_sched credential — the sweep role is per environment, like every other credential

EVIDGATE__TELEMETRY__OTLPENDPOINT.from: the staging collector endpoint injected at deploy (10.3.1-T2). Required because a staging release is what proves the telemetry path that prod will use (FR-10-5); the backend and endpoint themselves are [OPEN]

EVIDGATE__WORKER__HEALTHADDRESS.from: not set: the listener binds 0.0.0.0 inside the instance, which is what a container probe needs, and the edge/load balancer is what keeps /internal/* off the public ingress (00 §9.1). ⚠️ the container address and the edge rule are 10.2.1-T1's; a deployment states this explicitly if it needs another address

EVIDGATE__WORKER__HEALTHPORT.from: not set: the Worker's internal health listener uses 8081, which is what probes.worker.baseUrl below addresses

EVIDGATE_APP_PASSWORD.from: dev-stack only (scripts/dev/up.sh placeholder): staging holds the evidgate_app credential in the provider secret store, referenced by EVIDGATE__DATABASE__CONNECTIONSTRING

EVIDGATE_DB_PORT.from: dev-stack only (compose loopback port); staging reaches its database through the provider network, not a local port

EVIDGATE_DB_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD.from: dev-stack only; staging's bootstrap runs under the deploy identity (10.1.1-T3) and never uses a superuser password from this repository

EVIDGATE_MIGRATOR__CONNECTIONSTRING.from: provider secret store: the staging evidgate_owner credential, used only by the migration job (10.2.2-T1) and never by Api or Worker (00 §5.4.3)

EVIDGATE_MIGRATOR__MIGRATIONSPATH.from: not set: ⚠️ what the Evidgate.Migrator image ships is settled in 10.2.1-T1; until then the process resolves <application directory>/migrations

EVIDGATE_OPERATOR_PASSWORD.from: dev-stack only; the staging evidgate_operator credential lives in the provider secret store (01.4.1-T2, 10.7.1 operator runbooks)

EVIDGATE_OWNER_PASSWORD.from: dev-stack only: staging holds the same role's password in the provider secret store, referenced by EVIDGATE_MIGRATOR__CONNECTIONSTRING

EVIDGATE_S3_ACCESS_KEY.from: dev-stack only (local SeaweedFS identity); the runtime object-storage options and their staging credentials arrive with 06.3.1 and 10.1.1-T3

EVIDGATE_S3_BUCKET.from: dev-stack only; the staging bucket is provisioned by 10.1.1-T3

EVIDGATE_S3_ENDPOINT.from: dev-stack only; the staging S3-compatible endpoint is [OPEN] until O3

EVIDGATE_S3_REGION.from: dev-stack only; the provider region is [OPEN] until O3

EVIDGATE_S3_SECRET_KEY.from: dev-stack only (local SeaweedFS identity); staging's key lives in the provider secret store

EVIDGATE_SEAWEEDFS_S3_CONFIG.from: dev-stack only: the committed local identity is accepted by the local container and by nothing else

EVIDGATE_WORKER_SCHED_PASSWORD.from: dev-stack only; staging holds the same role's password in the provider secret store, referenced by EVIDGATE__TASKS__SWEEPCONNECTIONSTRING

api.baseUrlNote: the probe runs on the instance (container/sidecar) next to the Api, so it addresses the loopback port; ⚠️ the image's listen port and the probe's execution location are settled in 10.2.1-T1

worker.baseUrlNote: EVIDGATE__WORKER__HEALTHPORT default 8081, addressed from inside the instance

ingress.note: The load balancer forwards only /v1/* to Evidgate.Api; /internal/* and /metrics are reachable only on the internal path (the instance's private network), and /internal/operator/* additionally only on the operator ingress with an audited support grant (00 §9.1, TL T16). The rule is provider-neutral: it is implemented by the load-balancer/edge configuration of 10.2.1-T1 with the path lists above, and scripts/smoke-environment.sh --env staging asserts the internal paths answer while nothing exposes them publicly.
